userDecision: Require recent dated evidence before blocking; do not promote four undated vendor reports.

policy.requiredEvidence: A primary provider's explicitly dated malicious observation or current verdict within the window, tied to the exact hostname or justified domain scope, with no unresolved contradictory evidence.
notEvidenceOfFreshness: An updated page containing only old incidents
An undated statement that a vendor blocks a domain

method.mode: Passive search and reading of existing third-party pages only
limitations: Public indexed searches are not exhaustive reputation-database coverage.
No authenticated live reputation API was queried.

Web-hosted text files and list mirrors surfaced by search were discarded and not used.

recentSearch.result: No indexed result returned; not a clean verdict.

evidenceSources.title: pushame.com threat description
evidenceSources.assessment: Reports association with Trojan.Downloader and a domain block; no observation or update date supplied.

evidenceSources.title: pushno.com threat description
evidenceSources.assessment: Reports Trojan.BitCoinMiner association and miner hosting; no last-seen date supplied.

evidenceSources.title: pushwhy.com threat description
evidenceSources.assessment: Reports fraudulent notification and ad-rotation behavior; no last-seen date supplied.

evidenceSources.title: webmine.pro threat description
evidenceSources.assessment: Describes malicious browser mining and hosting CryptoLoot JavaScript; no last-seen date supplied.

evidenceSources.title: adskeeper.co.uk threat description
evidenceSources.assessment: Describes redirects to adware, without dated observations. This does not establish malware at every host or at adskeeper.com.

evidenceSources.title: visitweb.com threat description
evidenceSources.assessment: Classifies the domain as associated with riskware, without a last-seen date. Riskware is not equivalent to confirmed malware.

evidenceSources.title: Why is Malwarebytes blocking Coinhive?
evidenceSources.assessment: Discusses mining abuse and lists crypto-loot.com; explicitly distinguishes the Coinhive service itself from malicious use.

evidenceSources.title: Unauthorized Coin Mining in the Browser
evidenceSources.assessment: The report describes 2017 Coinhive activity, including coin-hive.com script URLs, and distinguishes voluntary use from compromise. No recent observation was established.

evidenceSources.title: Cryptomining is Here to Stay in the Enterprise
evidenceSources.assessment: Discusses Crypto-Loot and JSE-Coin in 2017-2018 mining telemetry, including both voluntary mining and abuse. This is historical context.

evidenceSources.title: Cryptojacking is almost conquered - crushed along with Coinhive
evidenceSources.assessment: Summarizes another research team's work and mentions minero.cc and webminepool.com. Excluded as proof of recent activity or as an independent primary finding.

evidenceSources.title: Glupteba is no longer part of Windigo
evidenceSources.assessment: Lists adfoc.us as a target of password-reuse attacks, not as the malware's command server. The mention does not justify a malicious-domain label.

evidenceSources.title: Rogue:Win32/Defru
evidenceSources.assessment: Updated 2017-09-15. Lists directadvert.ru and onclickads.net among destinations the malware redirects users away from. Those names are not automatically malicious.

evidenceSources.title: Birthday Reminder looks benign but the malware is anything but
evidenceSources.assessment: Shows onclkds.com in an ad-redirection chain that sometimes led to drive-by downloads. This is a 2017 observation, not current domain-wide confirmation.

evidenceSources.title: Magnitude Exploit Kit Activity Increases Via Malvertising Attacks
evidenceSources.assessment: Documents onclickads.net as an advertising intermediary in a campaign. No recent observation or whole-domain scope was established.

evidenceSources.title: The state of malicious cryptomining
evidenceSources.assessment: Describes AuthedMine as an opt-in API and contrasts it with silent mining. Service identity alone does not confirm a malicious domain.

evidenceSources.title: iZooto - Owned Audience Marketing Platform
evidenceSources.assessment: Publisher listing describes a notification marketing service. This is context, not a malware verdict or a clean bill of health.

evidenceSources.title: FastForward listing
evidenceSources.assessment: Listing updated 2024-04-01 describes sub2unlock.com as an action-gated link service. This does not establish malware.

evidenceSources.title: Instructions for Blogger/Blogspot: push notification code
evidenceSources.assessment: Publisher instructions use pushno.com for notifications. Service use is not proof of safety or malware; it also does not refresh the undated threat report.

evidenceSources.title: Pushame.com reputation report
evidenceSources.assessment: Existing report says last checked 2024-12-18 and gives a suspicious-shop warning based on automated signals. It lacks current malware confirmation and content analysis.
